archivedDataNotice: Archived real solar storm records from NASA's Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (CCMC DONKI / api.nasa.gov) — bundled offline for deterministic simulation, not a live feed.
sourceLabel: NASA CCMC DONKI — Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information

storms.title: G5 Extreme Geomagnetic Storm ('Gannon Storm')
storms.description: Multiple Earth-directed halo CMEs from Active Region AR3664 merged in transit, triggering the strongest geomagnetic storm (Kp 9) in two decades. Increases LEO thermospheric drag and forces spacecraft into safe mode.

storms.title: X1.1 Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) Radiation Event
storms.description: High-energy solar proton stream (>10 MeV, S2 radiation storm) elevated single-event upsets in basic flight computers and posed acute radiation dose risk to unshielded crewed or high-latitude polar missions; its CME drove a Kp 8 storm the next day.

storms.title: X9.0 Solar Flare & Fast Earth-Directed CME
storms.description: Strongest flare of Solar Cycle 25 up to Oct 2024 (X9.0 from AR3842), producing a halo CME, radio blackouts affecting S-band and X-band ground links, and a Kp 7.33 geomagnetic storm when the CME arrived on Oct 7-8.

storms.title: G4 Severe Geomagnetic Storm & Polar Radio Absorption
storms.description: Fast 1,500 km/s CME arrived at Earth's magnetosphere, driving intense polar aurora, S3 proton storm conditions, and temporary attitude-sensor blinding.

storms.title: New Year G4 Geomagnetic Storm
storms.description: Double CME impact compressed Earth's magnetopause inside GEO altitude, exposing high-altitude geostationary spacecraft to surface charging hazards.
